verdict.rationale: Databricks documents deep API/CLI parity for core platform objects — Unity Catalog objects are managed via Catalog Explorer, SQL, CLI, or REST APIs; the CLI wraps a raw `databricks api` command; and there are SDKs (Python) for automation — showing broad programmatic access to core data/compute operations mirroring the UI. However, no discoverable public OpenAPI/swagger spec was found (404s), and there is no explicit confirmation that newer AI-UI-only surfaces (Genie natural-language chat, AI Playground, AI/BI dashboard authoring) have full API equivalents. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/swagger spec, and explicit API parity evidence for Genie/AI Playground/dashboard-authoring UI features.
